DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自宅の防犯についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po ba sa seguridad ng bahay ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 玄関が夜に暗くなるので、照明の置き方について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の玄関照明について防犯相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Madilim ang pasukan sa gabi kaya gusto kong magtanong kung saan ilalagay ang ilaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humingi ng payo sa seguridad tungkol sa ilaw sa pasukan sa gabi. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 玄関の様子が分かる写真はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。門から玄関まで、植木で少し隠れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 植木で隠れた門から玄関を写真で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito. Bahagyang natatakpan ng halaman ang mula sa gate hanggang pintuan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Gamit ang larawan, ipaliwanag ang mga halamang tumatakip mula gate hanggang pintuan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人の出入りが見えにくいですね。照明や植木の手入れを含めて考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Mahirap makita ang paglabas-pasok. Maaaring pag-isipan ang ilaw at pag-aalaga ng halaman.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人が来ると点く照明を考えています。隣の家の窓に光が向かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人感照明の希望と隣家への光を避けたい条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iniisip ko ang ilaw na sisindi kapag may tao. Ayaw kong tumutok ang ilaw sa bintana ng kapitbahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang nais na sensor light at kondisyong huwag tumutok sa kapitbahay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 向きは取付け業者にも相談してください。門と通路のどこを照らすか整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itanong din ang direksiyon sa magkakabit. Tukuyin natin kung aling bahagi ng gate at daan ang iilawan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の足元を照らしたいです。防犯カメラも一緒に相談した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元照明を希望しカメラ相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong ilawan ang tinatapakan sa daan. Dapat ko bang itanong din ang security camera?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilingin ang ilaw sa paanan at itanong ang konsultasyon sa camera. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設置目的と撮影範囲を決めて、担当者に相談できます。防犯の資料もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itakda ang layunin at saklaw ng kuha saka itanong sa nakatalaga. May babasahin din tungkol sa seguridad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料をもらいます。写真に照らしたい範囲を書いて、業者へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料と照射範囲入り写真で業者へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kukuha ako ng babasahin. Mamarkahan ko sa larawan ang nais ilawan at kokonsulta sa magkakabit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang konsultahin ang magkakabit gamit ang babasahin at markadong larawan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お役に立てれば幸いです。お気をつけてお帰りください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ会社の別の部署へ送ります。それぞれ別の封筒のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ会社宛て二通を別封筒で送ると指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Magkaibang departamento ng iisang kumpanya. Pakipadala nang magkahiwalay pa rin ang mga sobre.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tukuying magkahiwalay na sobre ang dalawang liham sa iisang kumpanya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらも同じ住所ですが、部署名が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parehong address pero magkaiba ang departamento, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは経理部、もう一つは人事部です。封筒の重さも違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二部署の名称と重さの違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Isa sa Accounting, isa sa Human Resources. Magkaiba rin ang bigat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dalawang departamento at pagkakaiba ng bigat. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一通ずつ量ります。こちらは軽く、もう一通は規格を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Isa-isang titimbangin. Magaan ito; kailangang suriin ang kategorya ng isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 厚い方には冊子が入っています。中身を出さずに厚さを測れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冊子入り封筒を開けずに厚さ測定できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: May booklet ang makapal. Masusukat ba ang kapal nang hindi inilalabas ang laman?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong kung masusukat ang sobreng may booklet nang hindi binubuksan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒のまま測れます。こちらの料金になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Masusukat nang nasa sobre. Ito ang bayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料金が別々だと分かりました。二通の合計を払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別料金を理解して合計の支払いを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naintindihan kong magkaiba ang bayad. Babayaran ko ang kabuuan ng dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Unawain ang magkahiwalay na bayad at mag-alok bayaran ang total. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりの前に、両方に差出人が書かれているかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bago namin tanggapin, tingnan kung may nakasulat na nagpadala sa pareho.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方とも裏に書きました。部署名を変えずに、この二通を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人を確認し部署名を保って二通を差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nakasulat sa likod ng pareho. Ipapadala ko ang dalawa nang hindi binabago ang mga departamento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang sender at ibigay ang dalawang liham na di binago ang departamento. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かに二通お預かりしました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Natanggap namin ang dalawang liham. Salamat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座情報で分からないところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May hindi po ba malinaw sa impormasyon ng account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先に名義を伝えます。このカナの小さい「ャ」は、そのまま書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先へ伝える名義の小さいカナを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ibibigay ko sa employer ang pangalan ng may-ari ng account. Dapat ko bang kopyahin nang ganito mismo ang maliit na kana na “ャ”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang maliit na kana sa pangalan ng account para sa employer. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行に登録されている表記はこちらです。入力先によって、小さい文字の扱いが違う場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ito ang nakarehistrong baybay sa bangko. Maaaring magkaiba ang paghawak ng maliit na karakter depende sa input system.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録の表記をまず写します。最後の「ー」も省かない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録表記を書き写し長音の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kokopyahin ko muna ang nakarehistro. Hindi rin ba dapat alisin ang “ー” sa dulo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kopyahin ang rehistro at itanong ang mahabang patinig. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この口座の名義には長音が入っています。登録どおりにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kasama ang mahabang patinig sa pangalang ito. Ibigay ayon sa rehistro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写しました。名前の間の空白も、この通りに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長音と空白を含めて写したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nakopya na. Ganitong eksakto rin ang mga puwang sa pagitan ng pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing nakopya pati mahabang patinig at mga puwang. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。勤務先の入力画面で使えない文字があれば、担当の方からご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Kung may karakter na hindi tanggap ng screen sa trabaho, ipatanong sa kanilang kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行側で、今すぐ大きい文字の名義に変える必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入力先の都合だけで名義変更が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pala kailangang ipabago agad sa bangko ang pangalan sa malalaking kana, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kailangan bang baguhin ang pangalan dahil lang sa input system. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今すぐ名義を変えず、入力先の仕様を先にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Huwag baguhin agad ang pangalan; suriin muna ang sistema ng paglalagyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この登録表記を勤務先へ渡します。入力できない場合だけ、担当から問い合わせてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録表記を渡し入力困難時の問合せを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ibibigay ko sa employer ang baybay na ito. Kapag hindi lang maipasok, ipapatanong ko sa kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang ibigay ang rehistradong baybay at magtanong kapag mahirap ipasok. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてお帰りください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 惣菜の予約のお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May reserbasyon po kayo ng lutong pagkain, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方五時の予約ですが、六時に受け取りたいです。時間を変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取予約を五時から六時へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Alas-singko ang pickup pero gusto kong kunin nang alas-sais. Puwede bang palitan ang oras?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilinging palitan ang pickup mula lima tungong anim. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約のお名前と、商品の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pakisabi ang pangalan at produktong nireserba.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山田です。小さい弁当を四つ予約しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名と小さい弁当四つを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yamada. Apat na maliliit na bento ang inorder ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pangalan at apat na maliit na bento. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約を確認できました。六時まで保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Nakita ang reserbasyon. Maitatabi hanggang alas-sais.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。追加で一つ欲しいのですが、同じ弁当はまだ頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ弁当一つの追加を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Gusto ko ng isa pa. Maaari pang mag-order ng kaparehong bento?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang dagdag na isang kaparehong bento. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じものは四つまでです。店頭の別のお弁当なら追加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Apat lang ang ganoon. Maaaring ibang bento sa tindahan ang idagdag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約の四つはそのままにします。追加の分は、受け取りのときに売場で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約数を維持し別商品は当日選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mananatili ang apat na reserba. Sa pagkuha ako pipili ng dagdag sa tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang bilang ng reserba at pumili ng iba sa araw ng pickup. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約分の支払いも、受け取りのときで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Maaari ring bayaran ang reserba kapag kinuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六時に来て、予約の四つを受け取ります。そのあと、別の弁当を一つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六時の予約受取と追加購入の順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Darating ako nang alas-sais, kukunin ang apat na reserba, saka pipili ng isang ibang bento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkakasunod ng pickup nang anim at dagdag na bili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生会にご参加ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sasali po sa pagguhit sa labas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。画板は持っていますが、絵の具を置く小さい机を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写生用の小机を借りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. May drawing board ako, pero makahihiram ba ng maliit na mesa para sa pintura?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilinging humiram ng maliit na mesa sa pagguhit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折り畳み机があります。置く場所はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: May natitiklop na mesa. Napili na ang puwesto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の近くの木陰を考えています。通路から離れて置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の近くの通路外に置く計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa lilim ng puno malapit sa lawa sana. Ilalayo ko sa daanan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang planong malapit sa lawa at labas sa daan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付から運ぶ必要があります。一人で持てる重さか、試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Bubuhatin mula reception. Subukan kung kaya ang bigat nang mag-isa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持てます。脚を開いたときの固定の仕方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち運べると答え脚の固定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kaya ko. Pakituro kung paano ikakandado ang bukas na paa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing kayang buhatin at itanong ang pagkandado ng paa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この金具を、左右とも止まる位置まで動かします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Igalaw ang metal sa magkabilang panig hanggang sa hintuan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 固定できました。返すときは脚を畳んで、ここへ持ってくればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 固定を終え畳んだ机の返却先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nakandado na. Sa pagsauli, tutupiin ang paa at dadalhin dito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagsasaulian ng nakatiklop na mesa matapos ikandado. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。絵の具が付いた所は拭いてからお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Punasan ang bahaging may pintura bago ibalik.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 布を持っています。終わったら机を拭いて畳み、受付へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 布で拭いて畳み受付へ返すと約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: May tela ako. Pagkatapos, pupunasan, tutupiin, at ibabalik ko sa reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipangakong pupunasan gamit ang tela, tutupiin at ibabalik sa reception. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、写生をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの券についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po ba sa hawak na tiket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この回数券が一枚残っています。今日は途中の駅まで行くのですが、使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残りの回数券で途中駅へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: May isa pang tiket sa multi-ride set. Sa istasyong nasa gitna lang ako ngayon. Magagamit ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung magagamit ang huling multi-ride ticket sa intermediate station. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券面の区間内の駅でしょうか。行き先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nasa saklaw na naka-print sa tiket? Saan ang destinasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 終点の二つ手前の駅です。この区間の中に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 区間内の終点二つ手前と行き先を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dalawang istasyon bago ang dulo. Kasama sa saklaw na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang destinasyong nasa saklaw, dalawang hinto bago ang dulo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この券では、その駅で降りられます。ただし、差額の返金はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaari kang bumaba roon sa tiket na ito. Pero walang refund ng diperensiya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返金は要りません。降りるとき、この券は回収されるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返金不要と答え降車時の券回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi kailangan ang refund. Kukunin ang tiket kapag bumaba, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi kailangan ang refund at tiyakin ang pagkuha ng tiket sa pagbaba. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その一枚の利用が終わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Matatapos ang gamit ng isang tiket na iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。日付は来週までですが、今日も使えると確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券の有効期間と今日の利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naintindihan ko. Hanggang susunod na linggo ang petsa, pero pakitiyak na magagamit ngayong araw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang bisa ng tiket at paggamit ngayon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券面の有効期間内です。今日のご利用に問題ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sakop pa ng bisa sa tiket. Walang problema sa paggamit ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は残りの一枚で途中の駅へ行きます。降りたあと、この券は残らないと覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り一枚で途中駅へ行き利用終了を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gagamitin ko ang huli sa istasyon sa gitna ngayon. Tatandaan kong wala na ang tiket pagkatapos bumaba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gamitin ang huli sa intermediate station at unawain ang pagtatapos ng gamit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災訓練のお手伝いについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa pagtulong sa disaster drill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベトナム語で受付の案内を手伝いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベトナム語で防災訓練受付を手伝うと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Gusto kong tumulong sa reception guide sa Vietnamese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mag-alok ng tulong sa drill reception sa Vietnamese. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 話せる言語と、参加できる時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sabihin ang mga wikang alam at oras na maaaring sumali.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語と日本語です。朝九時から十一時まで参加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用言語と参加可能時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese at Japanese. Puwede ako mula alas-nuwebe hanggang alas-onse ng umaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang mga wika at oras na puwede. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 避難誘導の判断は職員が行います。受付で名簿や会場案内を説明する役割を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kawani ang magpapasiya sa paggabay sa evacuation. Ang iniisip na papel ay pagpapaliwanag ng listahan at direksiyon sa reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その役割なら手伝いたいです。案内に使う言葉を先に見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職員の判断と分けた受付役を選び説明文を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto kong tumulong sa ganyang papel. Maaari bang makita muna ang pananalitang gagamitin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliin ang reception na hiwalay sa desisyon ng kawani at hingin ang teksto. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明文をお渡しできます。意味が取りにくい部分を担当と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maibibigay ang teksto. Itanong sa nakatalaga ang mga di malinaw na kahulugan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読みました。「集合場所」と「受付場所」は違うので、訳し分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合場所と受付場所の訳し分けを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nabasa ko. Magkaiba ang assembly point at reception, kaya gusto kong magkaiba rin ang salin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang magkakaibang salin ng assembly point at reception. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会場図もあります。二つの場所を担当と照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: May mapa rin. Itugma natin ang dalawang lugar sa nakatalaga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図に印を付けました。担当と訳を合わせてから、当日の受付に参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図と訳を担当と合わせて参加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Namarkahan ko ang mapa. Pagkatugma ng salin sa nakatalaga, tutulong ako sa reception sa mismong araw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing itutugma ang mapa at salin sa kawani bago sumali. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よろしくお願いいたします。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Umaasa kami sa tulong ninyo. Salamat sa pakikiisa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か必要な物がありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定より早く生理が来てしまいました。ナプキンを持っていないのですが、一つ分けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定より早い月経で持参なしと伝え予備ナプキンを一つ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mas maagang dumating ang regla ko. Wala akong dalang sanitary pad. Maaari bang makahingi ng isa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing maaga ang regla at walang dala, at humingi ng isang reserbang pad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病棟に予備があります。普通の長さと、長い物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May reserba sa ward. May regular at mahabang pad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今夜も使うので、長い物をお願いします。自分で交換できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長い物を選び自分で交換可能と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gagamitin ko rin ngayong gabi kaya mahaba po. Kaya kong magpalit mag-isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Pumili ng mahaba at sabihing kayang magpalit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの未開封の物をどうぞ。明日の分は売店でも買えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Heto ang hindi pa bukas. Para bukas, puwede ring bumili sa tindahan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りました。売店が開くのは朝何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封用品を受け取り翌日の売店開始時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Natanggap ko na. Anong oras nagbubukas ang tindahan sa umaga?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang hindi pa bukas na gamit at itanong ang oras ng tindahan bukas. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 朝八時です。病棟の外へ出る前に、こちらへ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Alas-otso. Sabihin sa amin bago lumabas ng ward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八時に買いに行く前に声をかけます。使った物を入れる箱は、トイレにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病棟退出前の声掛けを了承し使用済用品の処分箱を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Magsasabi ako bago mamili nang alas-otso. May tapunan ng gamit na pad sa banyo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sumang-ayong magsabi bago lumabas ng ward at itanong ang tapunan ng gamit. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 便器の横のふた付きの箱へ、紙で包んで入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Balutin sa papel at ilagay sa may takip na lalagyan sa tabi ng inidoro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙で包んで、その箱へ入れます。今はいただいた物を使い、明日売店で追加を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包んで指定箱へ処分し今夜使用と翌朝購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Babalutin ko at ilalagay roon. Gagamitin ko muna ito at bibili ng dagdag sa tindahan bukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang balutin at itapon sa takdang lalagyan, gamitin ngayong gabi at bumili bukas ng umaga. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ほかにも必要でしたらお声をかけてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Sabihin kung may kailangan pa. Paalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa inyong kotse ang konsulta, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店の駐車場から戻ったら、ドアに新しい傷がありました。どう説明すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車後に新しいドア傷を見つけたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pagbalik ko sa kotse sa paradahan ng tindahan, may bagong gasgas ang pinto. Paano ko ipaliliwanag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang bagong gasgas ng pinto matapos iparada. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車は今どこにありますか。けがをされた方はいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nasaan ngayon ang kotse? May nasaktan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車は店の駐車場です。けが人はいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車の所在とけが人なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa paradahan ng tindahan. Walang nasaktan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lokasyon ng kotse at walang nasaktan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停めた時刻と、傷を見つけた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kailan ipinarada at kailan nakita ang gasgas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二時に停めて、二時半に見つけました。乗る前に写真を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐車時刻と発見時刻と撮影を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Alas-dos ako pumarada, alas-dos y medya ko nakita. Kinunan ko ng litrato bago sumakay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang oras ng pagparada, pagkakita at pagkuha ng larawan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と駐車した場所を確認しましょう。相手の車などは見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan natin ang larawan at puwesto. Nakita mo ang kabilang sasakyan o may kinalaman?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手は見ていません。店の入口に近い列の、端から二台目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手未確認と駐車位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko nakita. Sa hanay malapit sa pasukan ng tindahan, pangalawa mula sa dulo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing di nakita ang kabilang panig at ibigay ang parking position. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当から現場の確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naintindihan ko. Ipapaliwanag ng nakatalaga kung paano susuriin ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を見せます。車を動かす前に、担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を示し移動前に現場確認の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapakita ko ang litrato. Bago ilipat ang kotse, gusto kong marinig ang gabay ng nakatalaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang larawan at humingi ng gabay sa lugar bago ilipat. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、交通の担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ikokonekta kita sa traffic staff. Salamat sa pagkonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の宛名についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa pangalan at address ng tatanggap sa sobre?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宛先をこのラベルに印刷しました。裏の継ぎ目の上に貼っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先ラベルを裏の継ぎ目へ貼る可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Na-print ko ang address sa label. Puwede bang idikit sa dugtungan sa likod?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagdikit ng address label sa dugtungan ng likod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先は表の平らな面へ貼ってください。継ぎ目の上だと、剥がれやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Idikit sa patag na harap. Madaling matuklap kung sa dugtungan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ貼っていないので、表に置き直します。縦長の封筒ですが、横向きでも読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表に置き直し横向き表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa nakadikit kaya ililipat sa harap. Pahaba ang sobre, mababasa ba kung pahalang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ilipat sa harap at tiyakin ang pahalang na pagkakasulat. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この向きなら住所と名前が読めます。上の料金表示用の場所を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa direksiyong ito, nababasa ang pangalan at address. Mag-iwan ng puwang sa itaas para sa postage mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上を空けました。差出人のラベルは裏に貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金表示の余白を空け差出人を裏にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: May puwang na sa itaas. Sender label sa likod.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing may postage space at sa likod ang sender. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。端が浮かないよう、四隅も押さえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Idiin pati ang apat na sulok para hindi umangat ang gilid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四隅を押さえました。雨が心配なので、住所の上に透明なテープを貼ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四隅を押さえ透明テープの使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nadiinan ko na. Nag-aalala ako sa ulan, maaari bang transparent tape sa ibabaw ng address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Idiin ang sulok at itanong ang malinaw na tape. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 文字が隠れず、光で読めなくならない貼り方にしてください。こちらで状態を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Huwag takpan ang sulat o magdulot ng silaw na hindi mababasa. Susuriin namin ang ayos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: テープは端だけにします。住所が見えるようにして、この封筒を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字を覆わず端を固定し封筒を差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sa gilid lang ang tape. Pananatilihing kita ang address at ipapadala ang sobre.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikabit ang gilid nang hindi tinatakpan ang sulat at ibigay ang sobre. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拝見してお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
